meta.name: ab-test-setup
meta.description: When the user wants to plan, design, or implement an A/B test or experiment. Also use when the user mentions "A/B test," "split test," "experiment," "test this change," "variant copy," "multivariate test," "hypothesis," "conversion experiment," "statistical significance," or "test this." For tracking implementation, see analytics-tracking.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并实施A/B测试以优化转化率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要验证产品改动对用户行为的影响
copy.tagline_en: Plan and implement A/B tests to optimize conversion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to validate the impact of product changes on user behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会引导你完成A/B测试的全流程：先了解测试背景和当前状态，再用内置计算器估算所需样本量和测试时长，辅助设定假设、主指标与护栏指标，最后产出实验简报、预启动检查清单和结果分析报告。
howto.when: 当你想规划、设计或实施A/B测试或实验，或提到"A/B test"、"experiment"等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个A/B测试，比较两个按钮文案的点击率。
say.note: 会先了解现状并给出假设、指标和样本量。

say.text: 假设把CTA按钮改大并换对比色能提升新访客点击率，算需要多少样本。
say.note: 会运行脚本计算每个变体所需样本量及测试时长。

say.text: 这次测试结果是否统计显著？帮我写一份结果分析报告。
say.note: 会检查样本量、置信区间和护栏指标。

howto.what_en: Claude guides A/B test design: collects context and baseline, runs a sample-size calculator for sample size/duration, helps define hypothesis and metrics, and outputs experiment brief, pre-launch checklist, results report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user plans, designs, or implements an A/B test/experiment, or mentions keywords like "A/B test," "experiment," etc.

say_en.text: Design an A/B test comparing two button copy versions for click-through rate.
say_en.note: Gets context, then gives hypothesis, metrics, sample size.

say_en.text: Calculate sample size for a larger CTA with a contrasting color.
say_en.note: Runs the calculator for variant size and duration.

say_en.text: Is this test result statistically significant? Write a results analysis report.
say_en.note: Checks sample size, confidence, guardrail metrics.
